description: Trajectory of one game of the radar against the median of its niches (up to 3, largest first): 24 h growth, momentum, and retention 7 and 30 days after the peak (Roblox) or Epic D7 retention (Fortnite), each as game, nicheMedian and delta. A value not computable yet is null with its reason and daysMissing (days to wait; null when waiting will not help). Every game carries asOf (export time, UTC), source and grade (grade = completeness of the game record (A = 8+ of 10 data points known, B = 6-7, C = 4-5, D = fewer); estimate grade: B = tighter range, C = wide range, D = very rough order of magnitude.) Revenue figures are estimates with a range and a grade, never measured sales and never a guarantee. Definitions: resource wieldr://methodology.

game.description: Wieldr game id (e.g. "roblox-2640407187", "steam-570" or "fortnite-1234-5678-9012", returned by other tools), a Fortnite island code ("1234-5678-9012") or a game title (case-insensitive; the most played match wins, other matches are listed).

platform.description: steam, roblox, ios, itch (itch.io) or fortnite. Omit for all platforms.
